prompt: Is this a USABLE tissue slice?   (→ usable   ← unusable)
_notes: This is the default profile. Copy it to judge a different feature: change 'param' and the key->label 'bindings'. You can use Up/Down as well as Left/Right for up to four classes, e.g. add {"key":"Up","label":"borderline"}. 'label' strings must match whatever your classifier emits (or use --label-map in compare_to_classifier.py to reconcile them).
